seoTitle: Accessible Form Error Message Builder with aria-describedby
metaDescription: List fields and messages to get markup with aria-invalid, aria-describedby, a linked error summary and the focus script.
intro: Generates accessible form error markup, an error summary and a focus script.
why:
Errors must be found, announced and explained, not just coloured red.

The markup ties each message to its field with aria-describedby, sets aria-invalid, adds a hidden "Error:" prefix, an error summary with links, and CSS that does not rely on colour alone. Remember to remove the error state once the user fixes the value.
howTo: Enter id, label and message per line.

faq.a: It makes the failure announced; move focus to it as well.
Title is not reliably exposed and not for touch users.
